column3: The former palace of Puyi, the last Qing emperor, who lived here as the ruler of the Japanese-controlled state of Manchukuo. It is now a museum.
A museum in the old Changchun Film Studio, China's first state film studio, with sets and equipment of old movies.
A forested lake park outside Changchun, with pine woods, trails and a lake, popular for winter sports.
A museum of Jilin's history and culture, with relics of the northeast, such as dinosaur fossils and local peoples' crafts.
Slices of pork fried until crisp and coated in a sweet and sour glaze, a favorite dish of the northeast.
A winter stew of pickled cabbage and pork slices, simmered until tender, warming and tangy.
A street snack of cold noodle sheets grilled on a hot plate with egg, sauce and sausage, popular with students.
A pear frozen outside in the winter, which thaws into a cold and juicy, sweet treat.
A winter feast stew of pork, blood sausage and pickled cabbage, traditionally enjoyed by families when a pig is butchered.
A Korean rice cake that is pounded with a wooden mallet until soft and chewy, then coated with bean powder.
A comic song-and-dance duet from the northeast, with quick wit, bright costumes and a lot of humor.
A folk dance of the northeast, danced in groups with handkerchiefs and fans, popular at New Year.
An island in the Songhua River where, on cold winter mornings, frost covers every branch of the trees and turns the island into a white fairyland.
A large lake made by a dam on the Songhua River, a green summer resort, and an icy playground in winter.
A large ski resort in the mountains near Jilin, with long runs and a heavy snowfall, used for national and international competitions.
A hill park in Jilin City with the ruins of an ancient fort of the Goguryeo kingdom.
A big stew pot of fish simmered with vegetables and soy sauce, with flatbreads stuck on the edge of the pot.
Rime ice is frost that coats trees in winter, and it is one of the four great natural sights of China.
A volcano on the border with North Korea, with forests that change with the altitude, hot springs and a huge crater lake.
Heaven Lake fills the crater at the top of Changbai Mountain, a deep blue lake ringed by peaks, which is frozen for most of the year.
A tall waterfall that drops from the lake, known as the source of the Songhua River, and steam rises from the hot springs below.
A river that forms part of the border between China, North Korea and Russia, and flows into the Sea of Japan.
A hill with a Buddhist temple, a huge Buddha statue and the tombs of the rulers of the Bohai kingdom.
Chewy buckwheat noodles in an icy, sweet and sour broth, topped with beef, egg, pear and kimchi. It is the pride of the Korean community in Yanbian.
Korean-style barbecue, with meat grilled at the table and wrapped in lettuce leaves with garlic and sauce.
Rice, vegetables, egg and chili paste served in a hot stone bowl, where the rice at the bottom turns crisp.
Spicy fermented cabbage, or kimchi, made with chili, garlic and ginger, a staple on every Korean table.
A museum of the battles of Siping in 1946, which were a major episode of the Chinese Civil War.
Grilled meat skewers and other barbecue on the streets of Siping, a lively evening tradition.
A big lake, where every winter fishermen cut holes in the ice and pull huge nets through, in a traditional winter fishing festival.
Fish from the lake, caught in the winter fishing festival and cooked fresh in stews.
A huge stone stele from the fifth century CE, with thousands of carved characters about the Goguryeo kingdom and its king.
Ginseng grown in the forests of the Tonghua hills, used in tonic soups and in traditional medicine.
A sweet wine from wild mountain grapes, produced in Tonghua, one of the first wine regions of China.
A border river between China and North Korea that flows to the Yellow Sea, with bridges that connect the two countries.
Ginseng from Changbai Mountain has been valued for centuries as a restorative herb, and is grown in the forest under shade.
The forest frog of the northeast is a regional delicacy, cooked in soups and stews, and is also used in tonics.
